During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Codex" /> a twenty-eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] conflict spanning from [[3681 BBY]] to [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the Empire '''attacked''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Loronar/Legends|Loronar]] with a significant military force. However, the Republic troops under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Aves (general)|Aves]] were able to maintain control of valuable locations on the planet, and as a result the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was able to eventually drive the Empire off of Loronar permanently.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle at Loronar was first mentioned in the Codex entry for General Aves in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
